Hero_Desc_Arnet:
A Dragon who loves rushing anywhere a fight breaks out to watch.
Rather than the outcome, she enjoys witnessing the fierce battle itself.
Her dream is to someday watch a colossal duel that turns all of Elias upside down.
Album_Hobby_Arnet: Pitting two people against each other when their fight looks entertaining
Album_Wish_Arnet: To witness with her own eyes the incredible duel that exists only in her imagination
Album_Arnet1: Arnet loves watching fights. Whenever a duel breaks out among the Dragons, she runs straight over to watch from the front row. As a result, most Dragons who fight over their rank know her.
Album_Arnet2: I heard that Arnet also serves as a sort of referee among the Dragons. Since she always appears whenever a duel breaks out, they simply rely on her ruling when the outcome is unclear. Arnet herself now seems to take being treated as a referee for granted.
Album_Arnet3: One day, Arnet asked whether I would duel someone, anyone at all. She was not challenging me herself; she wanted me to fight somebody else... It was a request perfectly suited to someone who loves watching fights. Of course, I refused.
Album_Arnet4: I once saw Arnet talking with Ifrit near the Dragon Cave. The pairing seemed surprising yet oddly fitting, until I learned that Arnet was born near Ifrit's lair. Apparently, they occasionally greet each other in passing.
Album_Arnet5: It is surprisingly difficult to find Arnet around the Order. She usually spends her time refereeing duels in the Dragon Cave. Supposedly, she only comes to the surface when she senses the presence of a great battle... What exactly does a battle's presence feel like?
Album_Arnet6: Arnet gives such a strong impression of only wanting to watch others fight that I wondered whether she disliked fighting herself. Apparently, that is not the case. According to Rudd, she is quite capable in battle and holds a respectable rank among the Dragons.
Album_Arnet7: One day, Arnet told me about her dream. She wants to witness a clash between mighty champions so incredible that merely watching it would set her heart ablaze. The imaginary fighters she described were on an alarming scale: splitting the sky, overturning the world... I suspect it would be a disaster if her dream came true exactly as imagined.
LoveHero_Arnet: We are going to stand in the back and watch together, right, Master?
LoveHeroCancel_Arnet: Oh! Now I can watch from the back! Ahaha!
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Hate1: She pushed the cup away, saying she wanted to sip it slowly while reminiscing about spectacular duels, but it seemed to pressure her to finish quickly and leave.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Hate2: Apparently, this is a favorite thing for Dragons to throw when they dislike a referee's call. Being hit by the can would hurt quite a bit... No wonder she dislikes it.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Like1: She says sparkling ingredients always lift her spirits. Honestly, she looks more interested in making this than eating it.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Like2: She praised the perfect balance of sweet and salty, saying it was good enough to sell to Dragons gathered to watch a duel, and even picked up every last crumb.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Like3: She made the strange claim that the chewy rice cake and savory broth resembled fighting spirit boiling over, then tried to swallow it all at once. I stopped her and made her blow on it first.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Like4: She was put off by how soft and lukewarm it was, but one taste drew her in with its sweetness, and she ate as though she meant to scrape the plate clean.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Like5: She says shouting at the top of her lungs while commentating can be exhausting, and that having this powder on such days would make the fatigue disappear.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Like6: She said the way something popped out when poked reminded her of Dragons who were easy to provoke into a fight. After endlessly prodding the songpyeon, she finally chewed it thoroughly and ate it.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Like7: She says refereeing requires a great deal of thought, making sugar essential. Add nuts, and it becomes the perfect snack.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Like8: She wanted to take a huge pile so that listless Dragons could eat them and rekindle their fighting spirit. I stopped her and told her to eat only her own share.
Food_ChefNote_Arnet_Like9: She said something surprisingly mature about duels being most entertaining when each fighter's individuality is respected, then crunched away at it.

LoveLetter_Arnet:
Master! Have you been well?

I have been so bored lately. These are the kind of days when I crave a fight that sets my heart ablaze. Will we ever visit somewhere like the Frontier or a Great Clash dimension again? If the opportunity comes, please tell me. We can open some popcorn and watch the other Apostles fight together. All right?

As long as no major disaster breaks out, I hope to see you again in the banquet hall... If you want to challenge me to a cooking duel, just call. Challenges are always welcome!
LoveCall_Arnet:
Hello, Master! What are you doing?
I am waiting for the next duel with my heart pounding!
The match I just watched and commentated on was so dull and boring.
They just hesitated around each other and never even tried to attack boldly!
Honestly, I kept egging them on from behind, but they did not react at all. It was so frustrating!
If I traveled with you, Master, I am sure I would get to see all sorts of thrilling, heated duels...

Ah, Master! Come to think of it, does the Order have any plans to hold a dueling tournament?
A world of true competition hosted by the Order itself! It would definitely be a hit.
A referee? Do not worry! You have Arnet, expert duel referee!
I can even handle the broadcast and commentary too. How about it?
So please hold a tournament and invite me next time! Promise?
I will be waiting, Master!
